bridge.narrative: AMD's Advancing AI 2026 (July 22-23, Moscone) puts the Instinct MI400-series keynote inside the prediction window, the natural stage for a confidential-inference part, while Qualcomm's roughly $14 billion full-stack push keeps the merchant-accelerator race contested enough to reward a differentiated security SKU. Both are backdrop and venue, not a shipping accelerator with named attestation.
bridge.remaining_gap: No shipping part with on-die root-of-trust, TEE-I/O, and signed-model attestation as a named tier; the AMD keynote has not yet happened.
